CloudFile.title: CloudFile
CloudFile.description: Represents a file or folder stored in the user's DiskWala cloud drive, supporting folder hierarchy, video streaming playback resume, vault lock, offline caching, and link sharing.

userId.description: UID of the file owner matching request.auth.uid

name.description: Display name of the file or folder (1-200 chars)

mimeType.description: MIME type string (e.g., video/mp4, application/pdf, inode/directory)

parentFolderId.description: ID of the parent folder or 'root'

streamUrl.description: Direct stream URL or content URI for video/audio playback

durationSec.description: Media duration in seconds (0 for non-media)

playbackPositionSec.description: Last saved playback position in seconds for cloud streaming resume

isTrashed.description: Whether the file is in the Recycle Bin

isVaultLocked.description: Whether the file is stored in the encrypted Private Vault

isOfflineAvailable.description: Whether the file is cached locally for offline access

tags.description: Up to 10 string tags for organizing files

shareCode.description: Active share link ID if shared, or empty string

SharedLink.title: SharedLink
SharedLink.description: Represents an instant shareable DiskWala link for a file or folder with custom access permissions, optional PIN lock, and view/save analytics.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who created the share link

ownerHandle.description: Public handle/display name of the sharer (non-PII)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the shared item

sizeBytes.description: Size of the shared file in bytes

streamUrl.description: Streamable media URL for instant cloud preview

allowDownload.description: Whether recipients are allowed to save/download the file

accessPin.description: Optional 4-digit PIN code or empty string for public link

isActive.description: Whether the link is active or revoked

viewsCount.description: Number of times the link was opened/streamed

savesCount.description: Number of times the file was saved to another DiskWala drive

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when link was generated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when link was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

TransferTask.title: TransferTask
TransferTask.description: Represents an upload, download, or cloud-save transfer task in the user's Transfer Center with Turbo high-speed channel status.

userId.description: UID of the user owning the transfer

isTurboBoosted.description: Whether high-speed Turbo channel is active

UserStorageConfig.title: UserStorageConfig
UserStorageConfig.description: Stores per-user cloud storage quota, Turbo tier status, Private Vault PIN hash, and playback preferences.

userId.description: UID of the user matching document ID

quotaBytes.description: Total cloud storage quota in bytes

vaultPinHash.description: 4-digit PIN code for Private Safe Vault

autoBackupVideos.description: Whether automatic camera roll video backup is enabled

telegramLinkSync.description: Whether instant deep-link capture for shared links is enabled

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when config was initialized (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when config was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

/files/{fileId}.description: Root collection of user cloud files and folders, isolated by userId

/shared_links/{linkId}.description: Root collection of shareable DiskWala file links

/transfers/{transferId}.description: Root collection of upload, download, and cloud-save transfer tasks, isolated by userId

/user_configs/{userId}.description: Per-user storage quota, Turbo plan, and vault configuration keyed by userId
